ModMetaData.name: Bank of Rimica
ModMetaData.author: kanid99
ModMetaData.description:
A space bank for your colony.
Build a Rimica bank uplink and your colonists can: - Deposit silver (launched from orbital trade beacons) and earn interest. - Take out loans, delivered by drop pod. - Take debt collection contracts against defaulted settlements: send a caravan to lean on them, or destroy them to seize their assets. - Hold the bank's bullion in custody for a quadrum, half a year or a year. The holding counts toward your wealth, draws far more raids and at least one massive Bank Heist raid. Every bar stolen is charged to you.
Default on a loan, or refuse to pay, and the bank seizes your savings and puts out a bounty contract on your colony. Bounty hunters keep coming, bigger each time, until you pay or are destroyed.
Safe to add to an existing save. No Harmony required.
